title: Introducing Console
excerpt: Console is one API key for Drex, which decides with a calibrated probability, and Nace Document Intelligence, which reads any file. Run it in our cloud, your cloud or air-gapped.
content_html:
Execute your workflows with Nace Small Models

One API key for instant decisions with Drex, and for processing and grounding 36 file types with NDI.

Works with

Get started with our API

claude mcp add nace -- uvx nace-mcp

Or self-host our models

Drex 1.5 weights now available.

Leading performance at a fraction of the cost.

Parsing leaderboard export, 15 September 2026. Cost is USD per 1,000 pages as measured. ParseBench is scored on its main metric, Content Faithfulness, only.

Builders on Drex and NDI, in their words.

  • V

    Vishesh Baghel@VisheshBaghell · Sep 25

    $499,235 of unbilled work across 1000 work orders. @NaceAI's drex found $482,260.

    drex reads the note and the invoice and flags what's missing. code does the math. when drex isn't sure, a human decides.

  • A

    Aakash Kanojiya@Kanojiyaaakash1 · Oct 8

    I threw a messy PDF at Nace's new Document Intelligence model.

    Instead of just converting the PDF into plain text, NDI is built to understand the document's structure, extract useful information, and connect every extracted value back to its original source.

    It's a perception layer built specifically for AI agents.

  • I

    Ivan Fioravanti@ivanfioravanti · Sep 25

    Drex: faster, cheaper, better than jev, 32k context and with open weights coming soon? I will surely give it a try!

  • S

    SuperSaiyanColtSep 26

    I’m using Drex as a fast decision layer inside my project Elyreon/NOVA mainly for routing tasks, choosing tools/models, classifying failures, retries, urgency, and handoffs.

    the bot already responds sub 1s so i cant imagine how much better drex will make it

  • I

    Israfil@Israfilv2 · Sep 30

    Nace shows Drex playing a strategy game. i gave it a harder opponent: my timeline

    Spoiler Guard sends each post to the new decision model and blurs the spoilers, 352 post checked in one session with sub-second calls

  • E

    Eduardo OrdaxSep 25

    Using a massive LLM to decide which tool to call feels like hiring a CEO to sort your inbox.

    Drex targets those decisions: routing, ranking, classification and guardrails.

  • N

    Nawi@Aria_Nawi · Oct 8

    Earnings day is chaos. One filing, a mountain of invoices and a feed of X posts. One agent read all of it

    @NaceAI Document Intelligence read all three, and every value it pulls links back to where it sits

    the part I'd watch: when there isn't enough data, Drex says "insufficient data" instead of guessing

  • K

    Kai@hqmank · Sep 25

    Switching was easy. I pointed my existing Jev setup at Drex, kept the same SDK, changed 3 environment variables, and it worked.

    I see a good fit for agent routing, tool selection, document classification, and choosing the next action in browser automation.

  • D

    Dean W. Perkins@deanwperkins · Oct 6

    someone wired a small open model to a real security camera

    389 ms per call

    the vision model sees, drex decides

  • M

    MAX@MAXdeg0 · Oct 8

    i built a full NDI 1.0 trading system and open-sourced the entire repo.

    NDI extracts the information, grounds it back to the original source, then evaluates the decision while a frontier model reasons over the context.

    market data + financial documents + AI reasoning → trading decision.

  • G

    Gipp@gippp69 · Sep 30

    128k context means it can route with real state instead of tiny summaries.

    the interesting part isn’t more generation. it’s better decisions before generation starts.

See it work from a terminal.

An agent with a Console key reads an AP packet, finds the page that matters and decides what to do with it. Every call in the window is a Console endpoint, and every value comes back with the page it was read from.

Everything your agent needs, behind one key.

Authorization: Bearer $NACE_API_KEY

One key, one credit and one error envelope for both series.

  • Decision

    Drex puts a calibrated probability on every option, in one forward pass.

    Explore Drex

  • Perception

    Nace Document Intelligence reads any file and points every value back to its source.

    Explore NDI

Works where your agent works.

Console is plain HTTPS and JSON. Any harness that can call a tool can call it; these are the ones we test with.

Three ways in.

One platform. Four boundaries.

Same models, same API, same serving stack at every tier. The only thing that changes is the boundary around your data, from our cloud to your metal.

Your data trains your models. The weights, adapters and eval sets stay yours, inside the boundary you pick.

  1. Where it runs
    Our cloud

    Network path
    Public TLS

    GPU tenancy
    Shared

    Updates
    Continuous

    Managed Cloud

    Start on our GPUs, behind our API, with a key from Console.

    • Shared GPU pool with strict tenant isolation
    • Public API over TLS, no training on your data
    • Usage-based pricing, no infrastructure to run

    For: pilots, evaluations, mid-market teams moving fast.

  2. Where it runs
    Our cloud

    Network path
    Private link

    GPU tenancy
    Dedicated

    Updates
    Continuous

    Dedicated Cloud

    Your own GPU cluster in our cloud, reached over private links instead of the public internet.

    • Single-tenant compute, pinned to your region
    • PrivateLink or VPC peering into your network
    • Customer-managed keys, dedicated throughput

    For: regulated teams that are cloud-first but done with shared infrastructure.

  3. Where it runs
    Your cloud account

    Network path
    Inside your VPC

    GPU tenancy
    Dedicated

    Updates
    Pull from registry

    Your Cloud

    The platform installs inside your AWS or Azure account. Data stays within your boundary.

    • Runs in your VPC with your keys, your logs, your IAM
    • Updates pull from our registry; nothing flows back out
    • The deployment model our audit and banking customers run in production

    For: banks, Big 4 firms, anyone whose security review starts with “show us the network diagram.”

    Talk to sales

  4. Where it runs
    Your datacenter

    Network path
    None

    GPU tenancy
    Dedicated

    Updates
    Signed offline bundles

    On-Prem & Air-Gapped

    Your datacenter, your hardware, zero outbound.

    • No egress, no telemetry, offline license activation
    • Signed offline update bundles on your schedule
    • Ships as software on your servers or as a pre-configured appliance

    For: government, defense, and sovereign environments where the network cable isn’t there.

    Talk to sales

First request today. Your own cloud when you need it.

Create a key in Console and send your first request in a minute. When the data cannot leave your network, we bring the platform inside it.

content_html_zh:
Execute your workflows with Nace Small Models

One API key for instant decisions with Drex, and for processing and grounding 36 file types with NDI.

与

Get started with our API

claude mcp add nace -- uvx nace-mcp

Or self-host our models

Drex 1.5 weights now available.

Leading performance at a fraction of the cost.

Parsing leaderboard export, 15 September 2026. Cost is USD per 1,000 pages as measured. ParseBench is scored on its main metric, Content Faithfulness, only.

Builders on Drex and NDI, in their words.

  • VVishesh Baghel@VisheshBaghell · Sep 25$499,235 of unbilled work across 1000 work orders. @NaceAI's drex found $482,260.drex reads the note and the invoice and flags what's missing. code does the math. when drex isn't sure, a human decides.
  • AAakash Kanojiya@Kanojiyaaakash1 · Oct 8I threw a messy PDF at Nace's new Document Intelligence model.Instead of just converting the PDF into plain text, NDI is built to understand the document's structure, extract useful information, and connect every extracted value back to its original source.It's a perception layer built specifically for AI agents.
  • IIvan Fioravanti@ivanfioravanti · Sep 25Drex: faster, cheaper, better than jev, 32k context and with open weights coming soon? I will surely give it a try!
  • SSuperSaiyanColtSep 26I’m using Drex as a fast decision layer inside my project Elyreon/NOVA mainly for routing tasks, choosing tools/models, classifying failures, retries, urgency, and handoffs.the bot already responds sub 1s so i cant imagine how much better drex will make it
  • IIsrafil@Israfilv2 · Sep 30Nace shows Drex playing a strategy game. i gave it a harder opponent: my timelineSpoiler Guard sends each post to the new decision model and blurs the spoilers, 352 post checked in one session with sub-second calls
  • EEduardo OrdaxSep 25Using a massive LLM to decide which tool to call feels like hiring a CEO to sort your inbox.Drex targets those decisions: routing, ranking, classification and guardrails.
  • NNawi@Aria_Nawi · Oct 8Earnings day is chaos. One filing, a mountain of invoices and a feed of X posts. One agent read all of it@NaceAI Document Intelligence read all three, and every value it pulls links back to where it sitsthe part I'd watch: when there isn't enough data, Drex says "insufficient data" instead of guessing
  • KKai@hqmank · Sep 25Switching was easy. I pointed my existing Jev setup at Drex, kept the same SDK, changed 3 environment variables, and it worked.I see a good fit for agent routing, tool selection, document classification, and choosing the next action in browser automation.
  • AahmadghoOct 7i was using jev for playing vs a bot in an old game called Little fighter 2drex 1.5 is actually very comparable with jev's behaviour in game infact might be betteralso it's less latent and very fast i've dropped jev eversince and been optimizing for drex
  • DDean W. Perkins@deanwperkins · Oct 6someone wired a small open model to a real security camera389 ms per callthe vision model sees, drex decides
  • MMAX@MAXdeg0 · Oct 8i built a full NDI 1.0 trading system and open-sourced the entire repo.NDI extracts the information, grounds it back to the original source, then evaluates the decision while a frontier model reasons over the context.market data + financial documents + AI reasoning → trading decision.
  • GGipp@gippp69 · Sep 30128k context means it can route with real state instead of tiny summaries.the interesting part isn’t more generation. it’s better decisions before generation starts.
